transport.label: Transport
transport.source:
//# Transport example
name = "Alice"
count = 3
tags = ["draft", "public"]

note = >`
  Transport mode can carry broad AEON-shaped data.
`

strict.label: Strict

full.label: Full strict
full.source:
aeon:mode = "strict"
aeon:profile = "example.daily.v1"

entry:object = {
  title:string = "Daily check"
  published:boolean = false
  state:toggle = on
  count:number = 3
  tags:list<string> = ["field", "review"]
  point:tuple<number, number> = (12, 42)
  note:prose = >`
    AEON keeps the readable source, the typed value,
    and later interpretation visibly separate.
  `
}

copy:string = ~entry.title

symbols.label: Symbols
symbols.source:
//# Symbols are atomic values distinct from strings.
stage:symbol = |approved|
label:symbol = |in review|
escaped:symbol = |wait\|ready|
sameText:string = "approved"

temporal.label: Temporal claims

identities.label: Identities + references

highlight-themes.label: Highlight themes
highlight-themes.source:
//# Compare all three highlight themes without changing source.
label\label1\:string = "Widget"
number:number = 12.5
radix = %1011
date = 2026-11-17
time = 09:30:00
timestamp = 2026-11-17T12:00:00Z
flag:boolean = true
symbol = |ready|
address:sansa = $.label
node = <tag>

properties.label: Property address literals
properties.source:
//# Property selectors are inert address values here.
//# Evaluate them in the SANSA playground with an authoritative namespace.
items = [{name="Widget"}, {name="Bracket"}]
byName:sansa = $.items.*.name&key("name")
byTag:sansa = $.*&tag("widget")
quoted:sansa = $.["a&b"]&key("a&b")
byHead:sansa = $.**&headTag("widget")
